HACKATHON GUARDRAILS (non-negotiable):
- DEADLINE: 2026-10-12T18:25Z. Feature freeze 2026-10-12T06:25Z. You work on ONE task; stop when its acceptance passes.
- Read docs/DESIGN.md sections named in your task before writing code. src/types.ts is the shared contract:
  if you need a change, make it minimal and say so in your final message.
- Touch only the files your task OWNS. Never edit another task's files, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, setups/, experiments/.
- Tests: `bun test <your test path>` must pass and `bun test` (whole suite) must not regress. Never modify existing tests
  unless your task says so. Fixtures are built by scripts from real samples, never hand-invented payloads.
- Commit in small steps as work lands, message prefix "<task id>: ". Never rewrite history. Never commit secrets or .env.
- Never describe unbuilt work as done in README/docs. No numbers in docs except those generated into docs/FACTS.md.
- Use `entire graph impact --symbol <name> --json` (or `entire graph query`) before editing an existing module, if available.
- Final message: what you built, test output summary, any types.ts change, anything you could not finish.

TASK T29 · W1 · Setup identity counts every rules file the session loaded
GOAL: Two setups that differ only in an extra rules file (for example a CLAUDE.local.md) must get different setup ids.
READ: src/identity/index.ts, docs/DESIGN.md §"Recovering the model and the rules file from transcripts",
tests/fixtures/samples/claude-code-full.jsonl.
OWNS: src/identity/index.ts, tests/identity-rules.test.ts
BUILD: The rules hash covers every `instructions` / `nested_memory` attachment whose type is Project or Local (any file name:
CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, nested CLAUDE.md), sorted by repo-relative path, using their recorded content; user-level files
(type User, or paths outside the repo/worktree) are excluded and do not change the hash. Paths are made repo-relative by stripping
the session's recorded cwd, so the same file in two worktrees hashes the same.
ACCEPTANCE: new tests with transcript lines built from the sample shapes: same CLAUDE.md in two different worktree paths → same id;
adding a CLAUDE.local.md attachment → different id; a User-type ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md attachment → id unchanged. Existing identity
tests still pass.
TEST: bun test tests/identity-rules.test.ts tests/identity.test.ts
DO NOT TOUCH: anything outside OWNS.

105:### Recovering the model and the rules file from transcripts
106-
107-- **Claude Code `full.jsonl`:**
108-  - `type:"assistant"` lines carry `.message.model` and `.message.usage{input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, output_tokens}`.
109-  - `type:"attachment"` with `attachment.type:"model"` carries `identity.modelId`, e.g. `claude-opus-5-5[1m]`.
110-  - `attachment.type:"instructions"` (`files[].{path,type,content}`) and `"nested_memory"` carry the **full text of the CLAUDE.md files loaded**. That's the rules file. Hash the `type: Project` entries.
111-- **Codex `full.jsonl`:**
112-  - `turn_context.payload.model`
113-  - `world_state.payload.state.agents_md` (AGENTS.md)
114-  - `event_msg` with `payload.type:"token_count"` gives `info.total_token_usage{input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cache_write_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens}`
115-- **Copilot CLI and Factory Droid:** they record neither model nor tokens, so `cost = null` and the model is `unknown`.
116-- **Rules-file fallback:** hash `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` at the parent of the session's first linked commit.
117-
118-### Mapping recipe
119-1. List checkpoints from both backends.
120-2. Map each checkpoint to its commit through the `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailers on all branches.
121-3. For each `<n>/metadata.json`: `(session_id, checkpoint_id)` gives the token slice and the files.
122-4. Group by `session_id` to get one Session. Its tokens are the sum of its slices, and its commits are the set of linked commits.
123-5. Model: `metadata.model` if it isn't empty, otherwise the transcript.
124-6. The rules hash comes from the transcript attachments, otherwise from the parent-commit fallback.
125-7. The setup is `(agent, model, rules_hash)`.
126-
127-## Features and acceptance
128-
129-### Ingest
130-- **What it does:**
131-  - Partial clone (`--filter=blob:none`).
132-  - Fetch the `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch. If it's missing, fetch `refs/entire/checkpoints/*`. If neither exists, report "no Entire data" with a one-line how-to.
133-  - Parse each checkpoint into `Session` rows.
134-  - Map each checkpoint to its commit through the trailers on all branches.
135-  - Multi-session checkpoints become separate sessions. Subagent tasks attach to their parent. Sessions with no commit are kept with `commit_sha = null`. A commit with no trailer counts as human.
